name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; domain implied by rsrc.c (resource/portrait loading), descriptor accurately captures the two-phase behavior: (1) load chapter character portraits filtered by race_id into the sprite cache, then (2) dump the 0x32A00-byte portrait_sprite_cache to the FD2.TMP swap file. No address residue. Verified byte-identical against the KB (resource_info/fdfield.md), which documents the function as fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(target_race_id).
purpose: Load the chapter's character portraits whose char_spawn_record.race_id matches target_race_id (via fd2_init_runtime_char_for_battle), then rewrite the 200KB portrait sprite cache to the FD2.TMP cross-chapter swap file.
logic_summary: fopen("FDICON.B24","rb"); on NULL -> INT 10h text-mode reset + printf("File 'FDICON.B24' error !!\n") + exit(1). Re-reads FDFIELD.DAT[current_chapter_id*3+2] into data_fd2_chapter_portrait_load_buffer (the buffer was freed by fd2_load_chapter_battle_data after its own load). Iterates char_spawn_records of the tile-event table (count = data_fd2_resource_portrait_cache_alloc_offset, stride 0x1A; the byte at +0x98 = header 0x83 + record race_id at +0x15): for each record whose race_id == target_race_id, calls fd2_init_runtime_char_for_battle(record_index, fdicon_fp) to populate a runtime_char and load its portrait sprite from FDICON.B24. Then fclose(FDICON); free + null data_fd2_chapter_portrait_load_buffer. Finally fopen("FD2.TMP","wb"); fwrite(data_fd2_portrait_sprite_cache, 1, 0x32A00, fp); fclose -- truncating and rewriting the swap file so the working portrait set persists across chapters.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: race_id filter: only char_spawn_records whose race_id byte (entry +0x98 = header 0x83 + record offset +0x15) equals this value get their portrait loaded. Callers pass 0 from chapter battle-data setup (load the base record set) and small ids (e.g. 3, 7) from turn-event handlers to load reinforcement/cinematic character subsets (annotated 'load portrait set N' at call sites).
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_1; the value is the race_id selector compared against each record's +0x98 byte. src already declares it as 'target_race_id', which matches the KB and is the accurate descriptor (no address residue; the small numeric values are domain race/portrait-set ids, not address tails).

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects: populates runtime_char portrait slots for matching records and rewrites FD2.TMP from data_fd2_portrait_sprite_cache.
